note: The Data Protection Act, section 20(3): credit bureaus may not process information against creditworthiness more than five years old. Its four weeks' notice (section 17) is for public debt only. No source states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Databeskyttelsesloven (LBK nr 289 af 2024) (Retsinformation)
sources.said: Stk. 3. Oplysninger om forhold, der taler imod kreditværdighed, og som er mere end 5 år gamle, må ikke behandles
